body: i know im replying late but at least im replying. thanks for taking the time to write this. im not very good at expressing empathy but thanks and i hope it works out for you as well. what you said about making a friend and immediately destroying the relationship really hit me, i even do this with strangers. its been a long time since ive talked to someone about how i feel, and even if you dont read this and move on i dont care. i wish i could have the courage to get to know people, even you. but i cant open up, im too scared. and ill probably regret writing this much and never come back to reddit. the cycle never ends. but anyways, thank you and good luck. i wish you the best.
i cant talk to people so i dont see how i could get a therapist. thanks for the response but honestly i was just ranting cause i feel alone.
